body:
Sourced from the sacred terrain of the Himalayas, UV-Reactive Nepal Selenite is in a class of its own. This isn’t your typical Selenite—it’s lighter, purer, and vibrationally elevated by the altitude and stillness of its origin. And when placed under ultraviolet light? It reveals a stunning golden glow—a rare trait linked to its unique mineral composition and ultra-high vibration.

This is Selenite for those who are ready to access deeper layers of peace, clarity, and spiritual insight. It clears the crown chakra, supports emotional regulation, and filters out energetic “noise” so your system can return to baseline.

Use it in your meditation space, on your altar, or wherever you need a field-cleansing reset. Whether you’re an energy worker, a seeker, or simply someone sensitive to the overstimulation of the world—this crystal holds a frequency your nervous system will recognize as safe, clear, and elevated.

And because it’s UV-reactive, it’s also a beautiful visual tool—perfect for spiritual displays, ritual work, or activating deeper levels of energetic awareness under blacklight or sun-charged spaces.

Every piece is limited, natural, and one-of-a-kind. Once these are gone, they may not return.
